name: fieldnote-monorepo

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @fieldnote/contracts build && concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "pnpm --filter @fieldnote/server dev" "pnpm --filter @fieldnote/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @fieldnote/contracts build && pnpm --filter @fieldnote/server build && pnpm --filter @fieldnote/web build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @fieldnote/contracts build && pnpm --filter @fieldnote/server test && pnpm --filter @fieldnote/web test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @fieldnote/contracts build && pnpm --filter @fieldnote/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @fieldnote/web typecheck
scripts.publish:cli: pnpm build && pnpm -C packages/fieldnote publish --access public --no-git-checks

description: Fieldnote — local-first Claude Agent workbench for education: graduate admissions assistant and adaptive learning loop / 本地优先的 Claude Agent 教育工作台
